title: Govt cuts petrol price by Rs3.19 per litre, ups high-speed diesel rate by Rs2.25 - Investify
text:
Govt cuts petrol price by Rs3.19 per litre, ups high-speed diesel rate by Rs2.25 | Dawn | Investify Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Govt cuts petrol price by Rs3.19 per litre, ups high-speed diesel rate by Rs2.25
 Dawn • 27 Oct 2026, 11:36 PM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f The government has lowered petrol by Rs3.19 per litre and raised high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs2.25, with the revised rates taking effect on Oct 28, Dawn reported. Petrol will sell for Rs376.06 per litre and HSD for Rs398.07. The notification keeps taxes and duties at Rs114 per litre for petrol and Rs100 for diesel.
 The changes come as the government and Jamaat-i-Islami agreed to set up a committee to consider expanding fuel support for motorcycles, rickshaws and vehicles up to 800cc. JI chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman said the party would protest in Islamabad in mid-November if significant public relief was not announced. Petrol and diesel prices also matter to transport users and businesses, since the source notes their use in private vehicles, heavy transport, power plants and generators.
 At a glance
 Petrol falls by Rs3.19 to Rs376.06 per litre from Oct 28.
 HSD rises by Rs2.25 to Rs398.07 per litre.
 A government-JI committee will consider broadening the fuel relief scheme.
 Why it matters
 The revision affects fuel costs for consumers and sectors that use petrol and diesel, including heavy transport and power generation.
